reels.title: Cloudflare for Startups: Up to $250,000 in Edge GPU & Workers AI Credits

editorial_notes.reasoning: This offers the highest value-to-developer ratio ($250k) and allows for a 3b1b-style visualization of 'Edge' vs 'Cloud' compute, which is a core concept in infrastructure engineering.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could run a global AI brain from every street corner instead of just a central data center?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A relay race where the baton is processed at the closest track station instead of sending it all the way back to the national headquarters.
